explication: IPTV-API collects local and subscribed channel sources, normalizes and aggregates candidates, measures playback quality, then persists and publishes curated playlists/API results. Users can run updates through the desktop application, legacy Tk UI, or service/command entry points. The README also documents EPG, RTMP restreaming, playback screenshots, advanced filtering, and result management. Core orchestration and selected integrations are represented; unsampled implementation details are omitted, so some capability links are intentionally not inferred.
